title: Makapu'u Point Lighthouse Guided Hike
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for a guided hike along the iconic Makapu‘u Lighthouse Trail, one of O‘ahu’s most scenic and family-friendly coastal walks. You’ll be picked up from Waikiki in the comfortable Aloha Alfa and driven along the beautiful southeastern shore, where dramatic cliffs meet the Pacific.

This paved, easy trail leads to the historic Makapu‘u Lighthouse, perched high above the ocean. Along the way, enjoy stunning panoramic views of the coastline, offshore islets, and — in winter — migrating humpback whales.

With a friendly local guide, you’ll hear fun facts, stop at the best viewpoints for great photos, and soak in the relaxed, beautiful vibe. Whether solo, as a couple, or with family, this hike offers natural beauty, light activity, and a memorable local experience.

Come explore one of O‘ahu’s gems — we handle the details; you just come ready for adventure!
